title.zh: Osmosis发现bOSMO赎回合约漏洞，将向1037个账户赔偿约4.05万枚OSMO
title.en: Osmosis发现bOSMO赎回合约漏洞，将向1037个账户赔偿约4.05万枚OSMO

current_state.zh: Osmosis disclosed a bOSMO redemption contract bug that over-paid redeeming users by ~50% since April 2026, collapsing bOSMO's backing to ~0.06 OSMO per token and prompting a ~40,508 OSMO compensation plan for 1,037 affected accounts plus a warning against buying bOSMO or providing liquidity.
